{{Quote|Lightning Squadron! Reckless, snobbish glory-hounds and special-forces wannabes. Yeah, they rejected my application. But I didn't want to join them, anyway.|Sergeant Frumm|<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>}}
'''Frumm''' was an individual with the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who once applied to join [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], an elite cavalry unit that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and, later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The sergeant's application was rejected, which gave them resentment towards the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], leading them to claim they did not actually want to join the squadron, and referred to its members as reckless, snobby glory-hounds and wannabe [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]]. Sergeant Frumm had also participated in the [[Battle of Vulcusion]], which led them to be known as the hero of the Battle of Vulcusion.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frumm was quoted in ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', a supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'' by [[Wizards of the Coast]] that was published in [[2009]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> in a section written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Wallace">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/09/endnotes-for-galaxy-at-war.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Galaxy at War|date=2009-09-26}}</ref>
